# A night conifer: a short trunk and three stacked 6-sided cones, 2.2 m tall. Up Z.
new
material new Bark --base-color 0.1922 0.0196 0.1176 --no-slot
material new Needles --base-color 0.1922 0.0196 0.1176 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.1 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 0.25
material assign Bark
add mesh cone --name C1 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.62 --radius2 0.1 --depth 0.9 --location 0 0 0.85
material assign Needles
add mesh cone --name C2 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.5 --radius2 0.06 --depth 0.8 --location 0 0 1.35
material assign Needles
add mesh cone --name C3 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.36 --radius2 0 --depth 0.75 --location 0 0 1.85
material assign Needles
select all
shade flat
export tree.glb
